problem_type: Canvas generation entries treat a production-dispatched shot as idle and offer to generate it again
symptom: After the user confirms an Agent-drafted shot, the shot is queued in the production run, but the canvas bottom bar still says 「生成全部 1 个」 and the node's own generate button stays enabled. Pressing either submits the same shot a second time (double generation, double charge).
direct_cause: eligibleGenerationNodeIds (batch bar, frame menu) and canRunGenerationNode (single-node button and run controller) read only node.status. #870 made the production landing write generating / failed / result into the node record, but queued is production-only state and never reaches node.status, so a queued shot looks idle.
class_root: Whether a shot is being generated has two sources: the canvas node record and the production run. The canvas generation entries consulted only the first.
affected_population: Every user who confirms Agent-drafted shots (single or batch) and then uses 「生成全部」, the frame menu 「生成」, or the node generate button while the shot is queued
entry_points: Canvas bottom bar 「生成全部 N 个」 (useCanvasProductionActions → eligibleGenerationNodeIds)
Node composer generate button and run controller (canRunGenerationNode)
internal_only_reason: Internal state ownership between the canvas node record and the production run; no external API or library behaviour is involved.
invariants: A shot whose production state is queued or generating is never offered to or accepted by a canvas generation entry
The only judge of a production shot's phase is deriveProductionShotState; canvas entries consume it through isNodeProductionShotInFlight

invariant_owner_layer.why: isNodeProductionShotInFlight is the single renderer-side bridge from a canvas node to its production shot state; both canvas generation boundaries (eligibility and canRun) call it.

door_reduction.why_not: No door removed: the two canvas generation boundaries already existed and every entry goes through one of them; the fix makes both consult the production owner. productionRunIdOf moved out of ProductionShotPlaceholder into the shared helper (one copy).

generality_proof: All canvas generation entries converge on eligibleGenerationNodeIds (batch/frame) or canRunGenerationNode (single node, run controller); both now exclude in-flight production shots, so any future entry built on them inherits the rule.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Bridge from a canvas node to its production shot state; consumes deriveProductionShotState.
Which nodes a batch generation may include.
Whether a single node may start a canvas generation now.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Passes landing-store runs to eligibleGenerationNodeIds; productionShotOwnership.test.ts asserts a queued shot is excluded and a stopped one kept.
Same eligibility call with the landing-store runs.
canRunGenerationNode returns false for an in-flight production shot; covered by productionShotOwnership.test.ts.

recurrence.reason: Second instance of the same two-source shape within a day (#870: node kept spinning after production finished). Any new canvas generation entry reading node.status alone would reintroduce it.
same_class_scan: node scripts/door-map.mjs eligibleGenerationNodeIds: 2 callers, both pass runs
node scripts/door-map.mjs canRunGenerationNode: composer, run controller, generation index

prevention.invariant: Canvas generation entries skip shots the production run owns
prevention.failure_mode: productionShotOwnership.test.ts covers queued/generating/stopped/done and both entries; mutation-checked (removing either guard turns it red).
prevention.strategy: Fix at the two shared canvas generation boundaries, consuming the existing production owner; no second phase judge.

legacy_paths.rationale: No file removed. The private productionRunIdOf copy in ProductionShotPlaceholder.tsx moved into productionShotOwnership.ts (one copy).

residual_risks: The composer button reads the landing store at render time; if a run moves from queued to stopped without the node changing, the button may stay disabled until the next render. The run controller re-checks at click time, so no double submission is possible.
The structural cause (two execution engines, shot state in two places) remains; tracked as the 「两台发动机合一」 structural item.
